<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<base target="_top">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Virtus Legalis Awards Vote</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rye&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=Archivo:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* Layout: a theatre stage. Velvet curtains frame a dark masthead; the ballot is a programme of cream-lettered categories marked with gold stars. */
:root{
  --stage:#1D1924; --stage-2:#27222F; --stage-3:#15121B; --line:#3D3548;
  --cream:#F3E7D9; --muted:#B8ADBA; --gold:#E9B95C; --gold-tint:rgba(233,185,92,.14);
  --coral:#E5574B; --velvet:#8E140E; --velvet-hi:#D2321F;
  --err-text:#F6ABA3; --err-bg:rgba(229,87,75,.14);
  --display:"Rye", "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif;
  --serif:"Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --sans:"Archivo", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  color-scheme:dark;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;color-scheme:dark;background:var(--stage)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--stage);color:var(--cream);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.preview{background:var(--gold-tint);color:var(--gold);font-size:14px;text-align:center;padding-block:8px;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}

/* Masthead with curtains */
header.masthead{position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;padding-block:30px 34px;
  padding-left:max(calc(16px + var(--cw)),env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(calc(16px + var(--cw)),env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  --cw:clamp(18px,9vw,140px);
  background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, #2C2636 0%, var(--stage) 70%)}
.curtain{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:var(--cw);pointer-events:none;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--velvet) 0 6px,var(--velvet-hi) 9px,#5E0C08 14px,var(--velvet) 18px);
  box-shadow:inset -6px 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.curtain.l{left:0;border-bottom-right-radius:60% 30%}
.curtain.r{right:0;transform:scaleX(-1);border-bottom-right-radius:60% 30%}
.mast{position:relative;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.org{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left}
.org img{height:46px;width:auto;flex:none}
.org .names{font-size:13px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.02em}
.org .motto{color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:15px}
.event{border:1.5px solid var(--coral);border-radius:16px;padding:6px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;max-width:100%}
h1{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(34px,9vw,58px);line-height:1.02;margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--cream);text-wrap:balance}
.ticket{background:var(--cream);color:var(--stage);border-radius:12px;padding:6px;width:100%;max-width:520px}
.ticket > div{border:1px solid rgba(29,25,36,.35);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px}
.ticket .k{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.ticket .v{font-weight:700;font-size:16px}
.count{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#7A2A1F;font-weight:600}

main{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding-block:30px 150px;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.steps{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:0;margin:0 0 26px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.steps li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.steps li+li::before{content:"";width:20px;height:1px;background:var(--line);margin-right:2px}
.steps .n{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.steps .on{color:var(--cream);font-weight:600}
.steps .on .n{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--stage)}
.steps .done .n{background:transparent;border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;font-size:32px;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 8px;text-wrap:balance}
p.lead{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 24px;max-width:56ch}
label.field{display:block;margin-bottom:18px}
label.field span{display:block;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
label.field small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-top:6px}
input[type=text]{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:17px;padding:14px;border:1.5px solid #4A4256;border-radius:8px;background:var(--stage-3);color:var(--cream)}
input[type=text]::placeholder{color:#857B8A}
input[type=text]:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--gold-tint)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:8px;border:0;cursor:pointer;background:var(--gold);color:var(--stage);min-height:52px}
.btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
.btn:focus-visible,.nominee input:focus-visible+span,.linkbtn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cream);outline-offset:2px}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--cream);border:1.5px solid var(--cream)}
.btn.block{width:100%}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.6;cursor:progress}
.spinner{width:18px;height:18px;border:2.5px solid rgba(29,25,36,.3);border-top-color:var(--stage);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.alert{background:var(--err-bg);color:var(--err-text);border-left:4px solid var(--coral);padding:12px 14px;border-radius:4px;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:15px}

/* Ballot */
.matter{background:var(--stage-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin:0 0 16px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;min-width:0}
.matter legend{float:left;width:100%;padding:16px 18px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.matter legend .re{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.matter legend .cat{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;font-size:24px;line-height:1.2}
.matter legend .cat::before{content:"★";color:var(--gold);font-size:18px;flex:none}
.matter .opts{clear:both;padding:8px}
.nominee{display:block;position:relative;cursor:pointer}
.nominee input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.nominee span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:17px}
.nominee span::before{content:"";width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #7F7489;background:transparent;transition:box-shadow .15s,border-color .15s}
.nominee:hover span{background:rgba(243,231,217,.05)}
.nominee input:checked+span{background:var(--gold-tint);color:var(--cream);font-weight:600}
.nominee input:checked+span::before{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px var(--stage-2)}
.tray{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(21,18,27,.97);border-top:1px solid var(--line);z-index:5;
  padding-block:12px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.tray .wrap{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;justify-content:space-between;min-width:0}
.tray .tally{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.tray .tally b{color:var(--cream);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tray .btn{white-space:nowrap;flex:none}

/* Review */
.record{background:var(--stage-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin:0 0 22px}
.record div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.record div:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.record dt{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;min-width:0}
.record dd{margin:0;font-weight:600;text-align:right;min-width:0}
.record dd.none{font-weight:400;color:#857B8A;font-style:italic}
.row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.row .btn{flex:1 1 200px}

/* Sign-in and notices */
.signin{background:var(--stage-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:16px 18px;margin:0 0 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.signin p{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.signin .who{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-weight:600;min-width:0}
.signin .who span{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.linkbtn{background:none;border:0;padding:0;font:inherit;font-size:15px;color:var(--gold);text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer}
.notice{background:var(--gold-tint);border-left:4px solid var(--gold);padding:16px 18px;border-radius:4px;margin:0 0 18px}
.notice h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;margin:0 0 6px}
.notice p{margin:0 0 14px;max-width:56ch}
.reportflag{background:var(--gold-tint);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin:0 0 20px;font-size:15px}

/* Done */
.seal{width:120px;height:120px;margin:10px 0 24px}
.seal circle.ring{stroke-dasharray:340;stroke-dashoffset:340;animation:draw 1s ease-out forwards}
.seal path{stroke-dasharray:60;stroke-dashoffset:60;animation:draw .5s .8s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.seal circle.ring,.seal path{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
footer{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding-block:0 24px;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
footer i{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:15px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="previewBar" class="preview hidden">Preview only. Votes on this page are not recorded. Any name and reg number will work.</div>

<header class="masthead">
  <div class="curtain l" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="curtain r" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="mast">
    <div class="org">
      <span id="crest"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="UNSBA logos"></span>
      <div><div class="names" id="assoc">University of Nigeria Students' Bar Association (UNSBA)</div><div class="motto">Fiat Justitia</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="event" id="event">The Bar Dinner: The Black &amp; White Gala</div>
    <h1 id="title">The Virtus Legalis Awards</h1>
    <div class="ticket"><div>
      <div class="k">Public vote</div>
      <div class="v" id="closeText">Voting closes Monday 19 October, 11:59 pm</div>
      <div class="count" id="count" aria-live="off"></div>
    </div></div>
  </div>
</header>

<main class="wrap">
  <ol class="steps" id="steps" aria-label="Progress">
    <li data-s="1"><span class="n">1</span>Confirm it's you</li>
    <li data-s="2"><span class="n">2</span>Vote</li>
    <li data-s="3"><span class="n">3</span>Done</li>
  </ol>

  <!-- Loading -->
  <section id="vLoading"><p class="lead">Loading the ballot…</p></section>

  <!-- Step 1: verify -->
  <section id="vVerify" class="hidden">
    <h2>Confirm it's you</h2>
    <p class="lead">Only law students on the UNSBA class lists can vote, and each reg number votes once. Type your name the way it appears on your class list.</p>
    <div class="signin hidden" id="signinBox">
      <p id="signinHelp">Sign in with your Google account first. Your Gmail is saved with your vote so misuse can be traced, and each Google account votes once.</p>
      <div id="gbtn"></div>
      <div class="who hidden" id="whoRow"><span id="whoEmail"></span><button class="linkbtn" type="button" id="switchAcct">Use a different account</button></div>
    </div>
    <div class="alert hidden" id="verifyErr" role="alert"></div>
    <div class="notice hidden" id="usedBox" role="alert">
      <h3>This reg number has already been used</h3>
      <p>Someone has already voted with this name and reg number. If that wasn't you, report it and cast your own vote. The earlier vote will be cancelled. Your report is saved with your Google account, and false reports can be traced.</p>
      <div class="row"><button class="btn" type="button" id="reportBtn">Report it and vote</button><button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="notMeBtn">It was me</button></div>
    </div>
    <form id="verifyForm" novalidate>
      <label class="field"><span>Full name</span>
        <input type="text" id="name" autocomplete="name" placeholder="e.g. Okafor Chidinma Grace" required>
        <small>Surname and first name in any order.</small>
      </label>
      <label class="field"><span>Reg number</span>
        <input type="text" id="reg" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" placeholder="e.g. 2022/241875" required>
      </label>
      <button class="btn block" id="verifyBtn" type="submit">Continue to ballot</button>
    </form>
  </section>

  <!-- Step 2: ballot -->
  <section id="vBallot" class="hidden">
    <h2 id="hello">Cast your votes</h2>
    <p class="lead">Pick one nominee in each category. You can skip a category if you'd rather not vote in it.</p>
    <p class="reportflag hidden" id="reportFlag">You're voting after reporting misuse of your reg number. When you submit, the earlier vote is cancelled.</p>
    <form id="ballot"></form>
    <div class="alert hidden" id="ballotErr" role="alert"></div>
  </section>

  <!-- Step 2b: review -->
  <section id="vReview" class="hidden">
    <h2>Check your votes</h2>
    <p class="lead">Once you submit, your votes are final and can't be changed.</p>
    <div class="alert hidden" id="submitErr" role="alert"></div>
    <dl class="record" id="record"></dl>
    <div class="row">
      <button class="btn ghost" id="backBtn" type="button">Change my votes</button>
      <button class="btn" id="submitBtn" type="button">Submit my votes</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Step 3: done -->
  <section id="vDone" class="hidden">
    <svg class="seal" viewBox="0 0 120 120" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="54" fill="rgba(233,185,92,.12)"/><circle class="ring" cx="60" cy="60" r="54" fill="none" stroke="#E9B95C" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M38 61l15 15 29-31" fill="none" stroke="#F3E7D9" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
    <h2 id="doneTitle">Your votes are in.</h2>
    <p class="lead" id="doneText">Thank you for voting. Results will be announced at the awards. You can close this page now.</p>
  </section>

  <!-- Closed -->
  <section id="vClosed" class="hidden">
    <h2>Voting has closed</h2>
    <p class="lead">Thank you to everyone who voted. Winners will be announced at the awards.</p>
  </section>
</main>
<div class="tray hidden" id="tray"><div class="wrap"><span class="tally"><b id="tally">0 of 0</b> categories chosen</span><button class="btn" id="reviewBtn" type="button">Review my votes</button></div></div>
<footer>University of Nigeria Students' Bar Association · <i>Fiat Justitia</i></footer>

<script>
(function(){
  // When this page is hosted outside Google (needed for Google sign-in), paste your
  // Apps Script web app link between the quotes. Leave empty when Google hosts it.
  var API_URL = '';

  var IN_GAS = !!(window.google && google.script && google.script.run);
  var DEMO = !IN_GAS && !API_URL;
  var cfg = null, voter = null, choices = {}, timer = null, idToken = '', reporting = false;

  // ---- server bridge ----
  var demoCfg = {
    title:'The Virtus Legalis Awards', association:"University of Nigeria Students' Bar Association (UNSBA)", event:'The Bar Dinner: The Black & White Gala · 26 October 2026 · ICC, Enugu', logo:'', googleClientId:'',
    closesAt:'2026-10-19T23:59:00+01:00', isOpen:true,
    categories:[{"name": "The Phoenix Chamber", "nominees": ["Magna Associates", "Zenith Associates", "Olisa Agbakoba Chambers"]}, {"name": "Chambers' Leader of the Year", "nominees": ["Ugwu Victor Chika (Gustavo)", "Ted Eze Joshua (Jackie)", "Usoro Abasiama", "Udoagwa Johnpaul Jachike", "Ahon Elliot"]}, {"name": "Deputy Chambers' Leader of the Year", "nominees": ["Emmanuel Ekworonu", "Iheanacho Esther", "Diara Angel Ebere", "Eze Atuonwu Divine", "Agbo Mmesomma Faith"]}, {"name": "Most Promising UNSBAite of the Year", "nominees": ["Mackay Peniel", "Ikechukwu Valentine", "Chukwuemeka Orlu", "Ukadike Bright", "Great Emmanuel Chigozirim"]}, {"name": "Most Dedicated UNSBAite of the Year", "nominees": ["Amaka Emefionachukwu", "Asadu Arinze", "Nnamani Shedrack Chibuzor", "Eyi Henry", "Eze Chiamaka Martha"]}, {"name": "Most Dedicated Executive", "nominees": ["Kanu Sunday", "Agwu Cynthia", "Ukairo Stephanie", "Nwankwo Chioma", "Igwe Emmanuel"]}, {"name": "Committee of the Year", "nominees": ["Call to Bar Committee", "Moot and Mock Committee", "Judges Development Committee", "Disciplinary Committee", "Dinner Committee"]}, {"name": "Best in Client Advisory", "nominees": ["Emela Ralph Akudo", "Igwe Zitel Divine", "Anaje Chukwuemeka", "Nicole Ojigabani", "Ukairo Stephanie"]}, {"name": "Leadership Icon of the Year", "nominees": ["Ugwu Victor Chika (Gustavo)", "Nwanna Favour", "Udoagwa Johnpaul Jachike", "Udemba Okigbo Emmanuel", "Aniago Chukwuedozie"]}, {"name": "Director of Litigation of the Year", "nominees": ["Onwe Chukwuebuka", "Timothy Ogonnaya", "Ani Samuel Izunna", "Okechukwu Doris", "Amajuoyi Benita"]}, {"name": "SAUN of the Year", "nominees": ["Chidera Daniel", "Obiakor Chinenye Genevieve", "Udemba Okigbo Emmanuel", "Ted Eze Joshua", "Akangwu Dorathy"]}, {"name": "Best Draftsman", "nominees": ["Mozie Henry", "Nwanna Vincent", "Timothy Ogonnaya", "Amajuoyi Benita", "Igwe Emmanuel"]}, {"name": "Most Improved Advocate of the Year", "nominees": ["Stephen Nwafor", "PT Okoh", "Celestine Ebeku", "Ezika Chibuchi", "Jane Chukwuma", "Onah Kelvin", "Chukwu Cyril", "Jekwu Eze", "Emmanuel Great"]}, {"name": "The Unseen Pillar Award", "nominees": ["Mozie Henry", "Odo Godson Onyedikachi", "Ezinne Umeh", "Nnadi Makuochukwu Basil", "Eze Chinelo", "Ahanonu Tochukwu", "Chinaecherem Onah", "Okwor Benedeth Chinonyelum", "Ifeanyi Ogomegbunam Chukael"]}]
  };
  var demoUsed = {};
  function call(fn, args){
    return new Promise(function(res, rej){
      if (DEMO) {
        setTimeout(function(){
          if (fn==='getConfig') return res(demoCfg);
          var reg = String(args[1]).replace(/\s/g,'');
          if (fn==='verifyVoter') return res(demoUsed[reg] ? {ok:false, code:'used', canReport:true} : {ok:true});
          if (fn==='submitVote') { var was = demoUsed[reg]; demoUsed[reg] = true; return res({ok:true, result: was ? 'replaced' : 'counted'}); }
        }, 600);
        return;
      }
      if (IN_GAS) {
        var r = google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(res).withFailureHandler(rej);
        return r[fn].apply(r, args);
      }
      fetch(API_URL, {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}, body: JSON.stringify({fn:fn, args:args})})
        .then(function(x){ return x.json(); }).then(res, rej);
    });
  }

  // ---- helpers ----
  var $ = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
  var views = ['vLoading','vVerify','vBallot','vReview','vDone','vClosed'];
  function show(v, step){
    views.forEach(function(x){ $(x).classList.toggle('hidden', x!==v); });
    $('tray').classList.toggle('hidden', v!=='vBallot');
    $('steps').classList.toggle('hidden', v==='vClosed' || v==='vLoading');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call($('steps').children, function(li){
      var s = +li.getAttribute('data-s');
      li.className = s===step ? 'on' : (s<step ? 'done' : '');
      li.querySelector('.n').textContent = s<step ? '✓' : s;
    });
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
  }
  function busy(btn, on, label){
    btn.disabled = on;
    if (on) { btn.dataset.label = btn.textContent; btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>' + label; }
    else btn.textContent = btn.dataset.label || btn.textContent;
  }
  function err(el, msg){ el.textContent = msg || ''; el.classList.toggle('hidden', !msg); }
  var netMsg = 'Your connection dropped before we could reach the server. Check your data and tap the button again.';

  // ---- countdown ----
  function tick(){
    var ms = new Date(cfg.closesAt) - new Date();
    if (ms <= 0) { clearInterval(timer); $('count').textContent=''; if (!$('vDone').classList.contains('hidden')) return; show('vClosed', 0); return; }
    var d=Math.floor(ms/864e5), h=Math.floor(ms/36e5)%24, m=Math.floor(ms/6e4)%60;
    $('count').textContent = (d? d+'d ':'') + h+'h ' + m+'m left';
  }
  function closeLabel(iso){
    var d = new Date(iso);
    try {
      return 'Voting closes ' + d.toLocaleString('en-GB',{timeZone:'Africa/Lagos',weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit',hour12:true}).replace(' at ',', ');
    } catch(e){ return 'Voting closes ' + d.toString(); }
  }

  // ---- Google sign-in ----
  function needSignIn(){ return !!(cfg && cfg.googleClientId); }
  function emailFromToken(t){
    try { var p = t.split('.')[1].replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/'); return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(p)))).email || ''; } catch(e){ return ''; }
  }
  function setSignedIn(t){
    idToken = t;
    $('whoEmail').textContent = t ? 'Signed in as ' + emailFromToken(t) : '';
    $('whoRow').classList.toggle('hidden', !t);
    $('gbtn').classList.toggle('hidden', !!t);
    $('signinHelp').classList.toggle('hidden', !!t);
  }
  function startSignIn(){
    $('signinBox').classList.remove('hidden');
    var sc = document.createElement('script');
    sc.src = 'https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client'; sc.async = true;
    sc.onload = function(){
      google.accounts.id.initialize({ client_id: cfg.googleClientId, callback: function(r){ setSignedIn(r.credential); err($('verifyErr'),''); }, auto_select: false, cancel_on_tap_outside: true });
      google.accounts.id.renderButton($('gbtn'), { theme:'outline', size:'large', text:'signin_with', shape:'rectangular', width: Math.min(320, $('gbtn').offsetWidth || 320) });
    };
    sc.onerror = function(){ err($('verifyErr'), "Google sign-in couldn't load. Check your connection and refresh the page."); };
    document.head.appendChild(sc);
  }
  $('switchAcct').addEventListener('click', function(){
    setSignedIn('');
    try { google.accounts.id.disableAutoSelect(); } catch(e){}
  });

  // ---- boot ----
  if (DEMO) $('previewBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  call('getConfig', []).then(function(c){
    cfg = c;
    $('title').textContent = c.title; document.title = c.title + ' – Vote';
    if (c.event) $('event').textContent = c.event; else $('event').classList.add('hidden');
    $('assoc').textContent = c.association;
    if (c.logo) { var img = new Image(); img.alt = c.association + ' logo'; img.src = c.logo; img.onload = function(){ $('crest').innerHTML=''; $('crest').appendChild(img); }; }
    $('closeText').textContent = closeLabel(c.closesAt).replace('Voting closes','Closes');
    if (!c.isOpen) return show('vClosed', 0);
    if (!c.categories.length) { show('vClosed',0); $('vClosed').querySelector('h2').textContent='The ballot is not ready yet'; $('vClosed').querySelector('p').textContent='Please check back soon.'; return; }
    buildBallot();
    tick(); timer = setInterval(tick, 30000);
    show('vVerify', 1);
    if (needSignIn()) startSignIn();
  }).catch(function(){
    $('vLoading').innerHTML = '<p class="alert">The ballot couldn\'t load. Check your connection and refresh this page.</p>';
  });

  // ---- step 1 ----
  function handleFail(r, box){
    if (r.code==='closed') return show('vClosed',0);
    if (r.code==='signin') { setSignedIn(''); }
    if (r.code==='used') { err(box,''); $('usedBox').classList.remove('hidden'); $('usedBox').scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return; }
    err(box, r.message);
  }
  $('verifyForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    $('usedBox').classList.add('hidden');
    var name = $('name').value.trim(), reg = $('reg').value.trim();
    if (needSignIn() && !idToken) return err($('verifyErr'), 'Sign in with Google first, using the button above.');
    if (name.split(/\s+/).length < 2) return err($('verifyErr'), 'Enter your full name: at least your surname and first name.');
    if (!/^\s*20\d\d\s*[\/\\-]?\s*\d{5,6}\s*$/.test(reg)) return err($('verifyErr'), 'Enter your reg number like this: 2022/241875');
    err($('verifyErr'), '');
    var b = $('verifyBtn'); busy(b, true, 'Checking…');
    call('verifyVoter', [name, reg, idToken]).then(function(r){
      busy(b, false);
      voter = {name:name, reg:reg};
      if (!r.ok) return handleFail(r, $('verifyErr'));
      startBallot(false);
    }).catch(function(){ busy(b,false); err($('verifyErr'), netMsg); });
  });
  $('reportBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){ $('usedBox').classList.add('hidden'); startBallot(true); });
  $('notMeBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    $('usedBox').classList.add('hidden');
    err($('verifyErr'), 'Your vote is already counted. Each reg number votes once, so there is nothing more to do. Thank you!');
  });
  function startBallot(isReport){
    reporting = isReport;
    $('reportFlag').classList.toggle('hidden', !isReport);
    $('hello').textContent = isReport ? 'Cast your own votes.' : "You're confirmed. Cast your votes.";
    show('vBallot', 2);
  }

  // ---- step 2 ----
  function buildBallot(){
    var f = $('ballot'); f.innerHTML = '';
    cfg.categories.forEach(function(c, i){
      var fs = document.createElement('fieldset'); fs.className = 'matter';
      var lg = document.createElement('legend');
      var re = document.createElement('span'); re.className='re'; re.textContent = 'Category ' + (i+1) + ' of ' + cfg.categories.length;
      var cat = document.createElement('span'); cat.className='cat'; cat.textContent = c.name;
      lg.appendChild(re); lg.appendChild(cat); fs.appendChild(lg);
      var opts = document.createElement('div'); opts.className='opts';
      c.nominees.forEach(function(n, j){
        var l = document.createElement('label'); l.className='nominee';
        var inp = document.createElement('input'); inp.type='radio'; inp.name='c'+i; inp.value=n; inp.id='c'+i+'n'+j;
        inp.addEventListener('change', function(){ choices[c.name]=n; tally(); err($('ballotErr'),''); });
        var s = document.createElement('span'); s.textContent = n;
        l.appendChild(inp); l.appendChild(s); opts.appendChild(l);
      });
      fs.appendChild(opts); f.appendChild(fs);
    });
    tally();
  }
  function tally(){ $('tally').textContent = Object.keys(choices).length + ' of ' + cfg.categories.length; }
  $('reviewBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    if (!Object.keys(choices).length) { err($('ballotErr'), 'Pick at least one nominee before reviewing your votes.'); $('ballotErr').scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return; }
    var dl = $('record'); dl.innerHTML='';
    cfg.categories.forEach(function(c){
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      var dt = document.createElement('dt'); dt.textContent = c.name;
      var dd = document.createElement('dd');
      if (choices[c.name]) dd.textContent = choices[c.name]; else { dd.textContent='No vote'; dd.className='none'; }
      row.appendChild(dt); row.appendChild(dd); dl.appendChild(row);
    });
    err($('submitErr'),'');
    $('submitBtn').disabled = false;
    show('vReview', 2);
  });
  $('backBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){ show('vBallot', 2); });

  // ---- submit ----
  $('submitBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    var b = this; busy(b, true, 'Submitting…');
    call('submitVote', [voter.name, voter.reg, choices, reporting, idToken]).then(function(r){
      busy(b, false);
      if (!r.ok) {
        if (r.code==='closed') return show('vClosed',0);
        if (r.code==='used') { reporting = true; $('reportFlag').classList.remove('hidden'); return err($('submitErr'), 'Someone voted with this reg number while you were choosing. Tap Submit again to report it and replace their vote.'); }
        if (r.code==='signin') { show('vVerify',1); setSignedIn(''); return err($('verifyErr'), r.message); }
        return err($('submitErr'), r.message);
      }
      if (r.result==='replaced') {
        $('doneTitle').textContent = 'Your votes are in.';
        $('doneText').textContent = 'The earlier vote on your reg number has been cancelled, and your votes are the ones that count. Thank you for reporting it.';
      } else if (r.result==='hold') {
        $('doneTitle').textContent = 'Your report is recorded.';
        $('doneText').textContent = 'This reg number had already been reported once, so the UNSBA electoral committee will review all votes on it and decide which one counts.';
      }
      b.disabled = true;
      show('vDone', 3);
    }).catch(function(){ busy(b,false); err($('submitErr'), netMsg); });
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
